method: Whole-scene overview and every labeled target context crop inspected. Eleven severe candidates additionally checked using native-source magnified crops. Per-dog visual ratings are subjective, not blind detector miss rates or measured player times. Waterfall assessment also incorporates user feedback.
uncertainty: Provisional order. Treat differences under 2 index points as practically tied; no statistical precision is implied. Equal scores use level ID only for stable display order.
